title: Comparison Traits
summary: Eq, PartialEq, Ord, and PartialOrd for total and partial equivalence and ordering.
lecture: Rust separates total comparison from partial comparison to handle types with undefined orderings like floating point numbers.
PartialEq and PartialOrd allow comparisons that may fail or return false for equal representations like NaN.
Eq and Ord represent full equivalence relations and total orderings required by collections like BTreeMap.

example.caption: partial_cmp returns an Option.
